title: carduus lusitanicus subsp. broteroi
intro: Carduus lusitanicus subsp. broteroi, commonly known as Portuguese thistle, is a plant species in the sunflower family, characterized by its prickly stems and purple flowers. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which can aid in reducing inflammation, improving antioxidant defenses, and modulating the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Carduus lusitanicus subsp. broteroi include anti-rheumatic, antiseptic, and antiphlogistic properties, making it a potential remedy for treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
